notes.title: Alone In a Dream Demo 0.38v Patch notes
notes.notes:
Patch notes:
-Improved wall jump control
-Fixed the issue where the player experienced stuttering when simultaneously pressing the Run key and the Sneak key
-Improve menu control:
  ex)When you press the down arrow on the last menu tab, it moves to the first tab
-Change all dialogue to be printed without waiting if you press the next key during the dialogue output
-Fixed the issue that death instantly when it collides with a thorn in the boss battle

notes.title: [Alone In a Dream] Rework Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
Reworked with a new look, the first version of Alone In a Dream Demo has been updated!
You've been waiting for a long time. I'll continue to develop it in the future,
and I'll soon add more content and release it as Early-Access!

If you are installed the previous version,
please delete the previous version and reinstall it!
(After installation, check the version in-game: 0.36a)
Thank you.

notes.title: 0.15v Update
